title: Maser Activity of Organic Molecules toward Sgr B2(N)
question: What is the spatial distribution, excitation condition, and pumping mechanism of organic molecular masers (84 GHz CH3OH and 5.29 GHz CH2NH) toward Sgr B2(N)?

what.value: Locations of cm-wave continuum concentrations K1-K6

evidence.quote: The cm-wave emission concentrations (K1 – K6, Corby et al. 2015) are indicated by green dashed lines and circle markers

what.value: Locations of millimeter molecular hot cores N1-N3

evidence.quote: whereas the molecular hot cores identified in millimeter (N1 – N3, Bonfand et al. 2017) are indicated by orange triangle markers.

evidence.quote: was taken from the Excitation of Molecules and Atoms for Astrophysics (EMAA) database

recipe.goal: Image VLA and ALMA continuum and spectral line cubes
recipe.method: Subtract continuum in uv-plane (for VLA) and image spectral windows using CASA tclean with auto-masking and natural weighting.
key_parameters: VLA cell size = 0.27'', natural weighting, auto-masking
ALMA synthesized beam = 2.23'' x 1.67'' (84 GHz) and 1.94'' x 1.49'' (95 GHz), median RMS = 4 mJy beam^-1

recipe.goal: Compute extended collisional rate coefficients for CH2NH
recipe.method: Calculate rotational transitions among the first 49 levels of CH2NH colliding with para-H2 and ortho-H2 using the coupled-states approximation in MOLSCAT, and derive hyperfine-resolved rates via the statistical approximation.
key_parameters: EMAX = 1200 cm^-1 (p-H2) and 1318.64 cm^-1 (o-H2); total energies 2-800 cm^-1 (p-H2) and 120-918 cm^-1 (o-H2); Tk = 10-150 K
assumptions: Coupled-states approximation and statistical approximation for hyperfine splitting

recipe.goal: Extract spectra and model E-type CH3OH maser and non-maser transitions toward MS1 and MS2
recipe.method: Extract spectra of four uncontaminated E-type CH3OH transitions toward MS1 and MS2 and fit with a modified multi-component non-LTE RADEX radiative transfer model in molsim using MCMC.
key_parameters: 11 free parameters (Tk, nc, Ncol, dV, Vlsr for each of 2 components, plus Tcont); 100 walkers with 50,000 samples each (MS1) and 10,000 samples each (MS2); Ncol capped at 10^17.5 cm^-2 for MS1
assumptions: Local radiation field is CMB only (Trad = 2.725 K); uniform spherical geometry; H2 is sole collision partner with thermal ortho-to-para ratio; continuum source is spatially distant from gas clumps; 10% systematic uncertainty added to baseline RMS

recipe.goal: Model CH2NH maser hyperfine spectrum toward MS2
recipe.method: Fit the 5.29 GHz CH2NH 1_1,0 - 1_1,1 hyperfine spectrum toward MS2 with a one-component non-LTE model using MCMC, adopting CH3OH posterior distributions for Tk and nH2 as priors.
assumptions: 83 km s^-1 CH2NH and CH3OH maser components toward MS2 are spatially coherent and share physical conditions (Tk and nH2)
